CNN Data Guru Predicts Historic Blue Wave in 3 Key Races
results.description: CNN Democrats in the South could steer the party to an unusual wave of victories in the midterm elections, CNN’s chief data analyst predicted. Harry Enten said Democratic candidates Sen. Jon Ossoff of Georgia, former Gov. Roy Cooper of North Carolina, and state Rep. James Talarico of Texas are leading their Republican opponents by as high as double digits, according to various polls. “So three Southern states, three former Confederate states, and you see that Democrats are leading in them all,” he said on Thursday. “There has not been a Senate Democratic win in North Carolina since 2008. And in Texas, you have to go all the way back since 1988, so it could in fact be a historic year for Democrats in these three Southern states.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
